class.name: Friends
class.brief_description: The player's friends on Steam, Game Center or Play Games.
class.description: Who the player's friends are and, on Steam, whether they're playing this game and the lobbies they're in, to join or invite them.

method.name: get_all
method.description: Returns the player's friends, each a [Dictionary] with [code]id[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]playing[/code] ([code]true[/code] when they're playing this game), [code]lobby[/code] (the code of the lobby they're in, for [method Lobbies.join], or empty) and [code]invited[/code] ([code]true[/code] when they invited this player to that lobby). On Game Center and Play Games, the first call asks the platform for the list, which asks the player whether to share it: it's empty until they answer, and [signal changed] fires when it arrives. Neither platform says what friends are playing, so [code]playing[/code], [code]lobby[/code] and [code]invited[/code] stay empty there. Empty elsewhere.

method.name: invite
method.description: Invites a friend (an [code]id[/code] from [method get_all]) to the current lobby. Steam or Game Center tells them, and on Steam their game sees [code]invited[/code] in its list; accepting joins the lobby. Play Games has no invites.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when Steam is running, or the player is signed in to Game Center or Play Games.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted when a friend's status or lobby changed, they invited this player, or Game Center's or Play Games' list arrived: time to call [method get_all] again.
